FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards. afte r the draft finalized by the Builder' s Hardware Sectional Committee had been approved by the Civil Engineering Di visi on Council. Sliding door bolts are made from various materials like mild steel. bra ss a nd aluminium . However. in locati on s where atmospheric hum idity le vels arc high. o rd inary mild steel begins to rust. With the availability o f stain less steel of suitable grade, sliding door bolts which are rust proof. durable and aesthetically good looking arc now also available in stainless steel. Stainless steel sliding door bolts are espec iall y useful in coastal areas where humidity levels are high . Other Indian Standards available on sliding door bolts are:

The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value sho uld be the same as that of the spec ifi ed value in this standard.

STAINLESS STEEL SLIDING DOOR BOLTS FOR USE WITH PADLOCKS - SPECIFICATION
I SCOPE
This standard specifies the requirements (cgardlll g materials. manufacture. dimensions and finish of dip type stainless steel sliding door bolts used in general building construction for locking doors. gates, etc. with padlocks. 2 REFERENCES 2.1 The standards given below contain provisions which through reference in this text. constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication. the editions indicated were valid . All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below :

h.1 (;eneral

Sta inless sted sliding door bolts shall he well made and free from surface defects , The holt shall be fimshcd 10 the correct shape and shall have a smooth sliding action, 7 FINISH Unless otherwise ordered for, the stainless steel sliding door bolls shall be pol ished bright with smooth surface .

8 MARKING
8.1 Each stainless stee l sliding do or holts shall be clearly marked with the indicati on of the source of manufacture or trade-mark and the word 'Stainless Steel" shall be legibly imprinted.

The details of conditions under which the licence for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted tu manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards,

3 SIZES
Stainless steel sliding door bolts sha l l be of the following sizes: 200 rnrn, 250 mrn and 300 mm .

4 MATERIALS
The stainless steel used for the manufacture of tower bolts shall be as given in 4.1 and 4.2. 4.1 Sheet The stainless steel for sheet shall conform to Grades X07Cr 18Ni9 or X 1OCr17Mn6Ni4N20 of IS 6911. 4.2 Bolt The stainless steel for bolts shall conform to Grades X04Crl3 or XI2Crl3 or X04CrJ8NilO or X07Crl8Ni9 of IS 6527.

9 PACKING
Stainless steel sliding door bolts shall be suitably packed in cartons. Each carton shall bear a label showing the following: a) b) c) Source of manufacture or trade-mark.

Size, and
Quantity.

10 SCALE OF SAMPLING AND CRITERIA FOR CONFORMITY 10.1 Lot
In any consignment. all the stainless steel sliding door bolts of the same type and size and manufactured at the same time. shall be grouped together to constitute a lot.

5 DIMENSIONS AND TOLERANCES
The dimensions of sliding door bolts and tolerances thereon shall conform to those given in Fig. I.
